_standards: Parameter conventions, the confidence vocabulary, requirement classes and readiness tiers are defined in STANDARDS.md and enforced by catalog/schema/entity_schema_3.0.json. They are deliberately NOT restated here, so a data file cannot drift from the validator.
_readiness_note: The author's claim about this record. catalog.py computes the tier independently from the file's contents and test_catalog.py FAILS if the computed tier is below the declared one. Writing R3 here does not make a record R3.

mass_kg.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs - Takeoff Weight
mass_kg.note: DJI standard weight includes battery, propellers and microSD card.

propeller_diameter_m.note: CORRECTION: a prior spec file recorded 305 mm, which is a 12-inch prop. The 9453F designation encodes 9.4 in diameter (238.8 mm) and 5.3 in pitch. Disk area scales as D^2 and drives the entire induced-power term, so this error propagated into every endurance figure.

voltage_nominal_v.source: DJI Intelligent Flight Battery - Nominal Voltage
voltage_nominal_v.note: Consistency check: 15.4 V x 5.0 Ah = 77.0 Wh. Internally consistent.

voltage_full_v.source: DJI Intelligent Flight Battery - Charging Voltage Limit
voltage_full_v.note: CORRECTION: a prior spec file recorded 16.8 V, which is the standard-LiPo 4.2 V/cell figure. DJI specifies a 17.6 V charge limit (4.4 V/cell high-voltage cells).

voltage_empty_v.source: 3.5 V/cell discharge cutoff, typical for Li-ion 4S
voltage_empty_v.note: Not published by DJI. Conservative cutoff; DJI reserves roughly 2 minutes of flight below the displayed 0%.

chemistry.note: CORRECTION: a prior spec file recorded 'LiPo 4S'. DJI lists Li-ion.

performance_published._note: DJI measured these in a controlled environment: no wind, sea level, 100% to 0% battery, 1080p/24fps, APAS off, AirSense off. They are ideal-condition maxima, NOT operational planning figures. See performance_operational.

max_hover_time_min.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs page - Max Hovering Time
max_hover_time_min.note: CONTESTED: the DJI specs page states 40 min; the DJI product manual states 42 min. The lower figure is used as the primary anchor. A prior spec file recorded 46 min here, which is the max FLIGHT time line, not the hover line - the two are physically distinct because forward flight gains translational lift.

max_flight_time_min.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs page - Max Flight Time
max_flight_time_min.note: Measured at a constant 32.4 kph (9.0 m/s). This is a CRUISE figure, not a hover figure.

max_flight_distance_km.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs - Max Flight Distance

max_speed_ms.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs - Max Horizontal Speed at sea level
max_speed_ms.note: Capped at 19 m/s in EU regions.

max_wind_resistance_ms.source: DJI Mavic 3 Classic specs - Max Wind Speed Resistance

performance_operational._note: Independent measured performance. Real-world endurance is consistently 65-75% of DJI's advertised figures. For mission planning, using the published maxima overstates endurance by roughly 30%, which is the dangerous direction to err.

observed_flight_time_min.source: TechRadar review (~30 min to RTH prompt); Pix-Pro review (35 min to 20% at 0-1 C, zero wind); MavicPilots owner reports (30-35 min typical)

observed_hover_time_min.source: MavicPilots owner reports; comparable DJI Air 3 hover logging

usable_energy_fraction.source: Operational practice: land at 15% reserve rather than 0%
usable_energy_fraction.note: Separable, defensible component of the derating. Not a fudge factor.

operational_overhead_factor.source: Real-world power draw above ideal-condition lab conditions: gusts, temperature, maneuvering, active recording
operational_overhead_factor.note: Second separable component. Combined derate = 0.85 / 1.18 = 0.720, which reproduces observed 28.8 min hover and 33.1 min cruise against measured 28-30 and 30-35.

air_density_kg_m3.note: Cross-checked at runtime against EnvironmentState.air_density reported by the simulation (prediction P5).

equivalent_flat_plate_area_m2.source: Hattenberger et al. 2023, Evaluation of drag coefficient for a quadrotor model; Theys and De Schutter 2020, forward flight tests. Mavic-class CdA range 0.005-0.020.
equivalent_flat_plate_area_m2.note: CORRECTION: a prior spec file used Cd 0.8 x A 0.05 = 0.04 m^2, which is 2-8x the literature range. Independently corroborated: the Cosys-AirSim generic quad's own drag model yields an effective CdA of 0.0108-0.0117 m^2, derived from MultiRotorPhysicsBody.hpp:190-217.

figure_of_merit.source: Typical rotor figure of merit for small high-disk-loading rotors

motor_esc_efficiency.source: Combined brushless motor and ESC efficiency at cruise loading

propulsive_efficiency.source: Rotor propulsive efficiency in forward flight

avionics_power_w.source: Flight computer, gimbal, camera, OcuSync transmission
avionics_power_w.note: 13% of hover draw. Sensitivity is reported in the model self-test.

thrust_coefficient.source: C_T for a 9-10 inch two-blade propeller (UIUC propeller database range)
thrust_coefficient.note: Used only to estimate hover RPM for the advance-ratio term in profile power. Endurance is weakly sensitive to it.

profile_power_mu_factor.source: Standard rotorcraft profile-power growth term P = P0 * (1 + 4.65 * mu^2)

calibration._note: Exactly ONE parameter is fitted. Everything else is published, derived or taken from literature. The fitted anchor cannot fail by construction and is never scored as PASS.
